37enum Table {
38    Upper,
39    Lower,
40    Mixed,
41    Digit,
42    Punct,
43    Binary,
44}

76pub fn decode(detectorRXingResult: &AztecDetectorRXingResult) -> Result<DecoderRXingResult> {
77    //let mut detectorRXingResult = detectorRXingResult.clone();
78    let matrix = detectorRXingResult.getBits();
79    let rawbits = extract_bits(detectorRXingResult, matrix);
80    let corrected_bits = correct_bits(detectorRXingResult, &rawbits)?;
81    let raw_bytes = convertBoolArrayToByteArray(&corrected_bits.correct_bits);
82    let result = get_encoded_data(&corrected_bits.correct_bits);
83    let mut decoder_rxing_result = DecoderRXingResult::new(
84        raw_bytes,
85        result?,
86        Vec::new(),
87        format!("{}%", corrected_bits.ec_level),
88    );
89    decoder_rxing_result.setNumBits(corrected_bits.correct_bits.len());
90
91    Ok(decoder_rxing_result)
92}

99/**
100 * Gets the string encoded in the aztec code bits
101 *
102 * @return the decoded string
103 */
104fn get_encoded_data(corrected_bits: &[bool]) -> Result<String> {
105    let end_index = corrected_bits.len();
106    let mut latch_table = Table::Upper; // table most recently latched to
107    let mut shift_table = Table::Upper; // table to use for the next read
108
109    // Final decoded string result
110    // (correctedBits-5) / 4 is an upper bound on the size (all-digit result)
111    let mut result = String::with_capacity((corrected_bits.len() - 5) / 4);
112
113    // Intermediary buffer of decoded bytes, which is decoded into a string and flushed
114    // when character encoding changes (ECI) or input ends.
115    let mut decoded_bytes: Vec<u8> = Vec::new();
116
117    let mut encdr: CharacterSet = CharacterSet::ISO8859_1;
118
119    let mut index = 0;
120
121    'main: while index < end_index {
122        if shift_table == Table::Binary {
123            if end_index - index < 5 {
124                break;
125            }
126            let mut length = read_code(corrected_bits, index, 5);
127            index += 5;
128            if length == 0 {
129                if end_index - index < 11 {
130                    break;
131                }
132                length = read_code(corrected_bits, index, 11) + 31;
133                index += 11;
134            }
135            for _char_count in 0..length {
136                // for (int charCount = 0; charCount < length; charCount++) {
137                if end_index - index < 8 {
138                    //index = end_index; // Force outer loop to exit
139                    break 'main;
140                }
141                let code = read_code(corrected_bits, index, 8);
142                decoded_bytes.push(code as u8);
143                index += 8;
144            }
145            // Go back to whatever mode we had been in
146            shift_table = latch_table;
147        } else {
148            let size = if shift_table == Table::Digit { 4 } else { 5 };
149            if end_index - index < size {
150                break;
151            }
152            let code = read_code(corrected_bits, index, size);
153            index += size;
154            let str = get_character(shift_table, code)?;
155            if "FLG(n)" == str {
156                if end_index - index < 3 {
157                    break;
158                }
159                let mut n = read_code(corrected_bits, index, 3);
160                index += 3;
161                //  flush bytes, FLG changes state
162                result.push_str(&encdr.decode(&decoded_bytes)?);
163
164                decoded_bytes.clear();
165                match n {
166                    0 => result.push(29 as char), // translate FNC1 as ASCII 29
167                    7 => return Err(Exceptions::format_with("FLG(7) is reserved and illegal")), // FLG(7) is reserved and illegal
168                    _ => {
169                        // ECI is decimal integer encoded as 1-6 codes in DIGIT mode
170                        let mut eci = 0;
171                        if end_index - index < 4 * (n as usize) {
172                            break;
173                        }
174                        while n > 0 {
175                            //while (n-- > 0) {
176                            let next_digit = read_code(corrected_bits, index, 4);
177                            index += 4;
178                            if !(2..=11).contains(&next_digit) {
179                                return Err(Exceptions::format_with("Not a decimal digit"));
180                                // Not a decimal digit
181                            }
182                            eci = eci * 10 + (next_digit - 2);
183                            n -= 1;
184                        }
185                        let charset_eci: Eci = eci.into();
186                        if charset_eci == Eci::Unknown {
187                            return Err(Exceptions::format_with("Charset must exist"));
188                        }
189                        encdr = charset_eci.into();
190                    }
191                }
192                // Go back to whatever mode we had been in
193                shift_table = latch_table;
194            } else if str.starts_with("CTRL_") {
195                // Table changes
196                // ISO/IEC 24778:2008 prescribes ending a shift sequence in the mode from which it was invoked.
197                // That's including when that mode is a shift.
198                // Our test case dlusbs.png for issue #642 exercises that.
199                latch_table = shift_table; // Latch the current mode, so as to return to Upper after U/S B/S
200
201                let mut chars = str.chars();
202
203                // Advance to index 5 and pull that char out:
204                let c5 = chars.nth(5).ok_or(Exceptions::INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS)?;
205
206                // The iterator is now positioned at index 6, so the very next call is your index 6:
207                let c6 = chars.next().ok_or(Exceptions::INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS)?;
208
209                shift_table = getTable(c5);
210                if c6 == 'L' {
211                    latch_table = shift_table;
212                }
213            } else {
214                // Though stored as a table of strings for convenience, codes actually represent 1 or 2 *bytes*.
215
216                let b = str.as_bytes();
217                //let b = str.getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
218                //decodedBytes.write(b, 0, b.length);
219                for bt in b {
220                    decoded_bytes.push(*bt);
221                }
222                // Go back to whatever mode we had been in
223                shift_table = latch_table;
224            }
225        }
226    }
227    //try {
228    if let Ok(str) = encdr.decode(&decoded_bytes) {
229        result.push_str(&str);
230    } else {
231        return Err(Exceptions::illegal_state_with("bad encoding"));
232    }
233    //   result.push_str(decodedBytes.toString(encoding.name()));
234    //} catch (UnsupportedEncodingException uee) {
235    // can't happen
236    //throw new IllegalStateException(uee);
237    //}
238    Ok(result)
239}

241/**
242 * gets the table corresponding to the char passed
243 */
244fn getTable(t: char) -> Table {
245    match t {
246        'L' => Table::Lower,
247        'P' => Table::Punct,
248        'M' => Table::Mixed,
249        'D' => Table::Digit,
250        'B' => Table::Binary,
251        _ => Table::Upper,
252    }
253    // switch (t) {

270/**
271 * Gets the character (or string) corresponding to the passed code in the given table
272 *
273 * @param table the table used
274 * @param code the code of the character
275 */
276fn get_character(table: Table, code: u32) -> Result<&'static str> {
277    match table {
278        Table::Upper => Ok(UPPER_TABLE[code as usize]),
279        Table::Lower => Ok(LOWER_TABLE[code as usize]),
280        Table::Mixed => Ok(MIXED_TABLE[code as usize]),
281        Table::Digit => Ok(DIGIT_TABLE[code as usize]),
282        Table::Punct => Ok(PUNCT_TABLE[code as usize]),
283        _ => Err(Exceptions::illegal_state_with("Bad table")),
284    }
285    // switch (table) {

314/**
315 * <p>Performs RS error correction on an array of bits.</p>
316 *
317 * @return the corrected array
318 * @throws FormatException if the input contains too many errors
319 */
320fn correct_bits(
321    ddata: &AztecDetectorRXingResult,
322    rawbits: &[bool],
323) -> Result<CorrectedBitsRXingResult> {
324    let gf: GenericGFRef;
325    let codeword_size;
326
327    if ddata.getNbLayers() <= 2 {
328        codeword_size = 6;
329        gf = get_predefined_genericgf(PredefinedGenericGF::AztecData6); //GenericGF.AZTEC_DATA_6;
330    } else if ddata.getNbLayers() <= 8 {
331        codeword_size = 8;
332        gf = get_predefined_genericgf(PredefinedGenericGF::AztecData8); //GenericGF.AZTEC_DATA_8;
333    } else if ddata.getNbLayers() <= 22 {
334        codeword_size = 10;
335        gf = get_predefined_genericgf(PredefinedGenericGF::AztecData10); //GenericGF.AZTEC_DATA_10;
336    } else {
337        codeword_size = 12;
338        gf = get_predefined_genericgf(PredefinedGenericGF::AztecData12); //GenericGF.AZTEC_DATA_12;
339    }
340
341    let num_data_codewords = ddata.getNbDatablocks();
342    let num_codewords = rawbits.len() / codeword_size;
343    if num_codewords < num_data_codewords as usize {
344        return Err(Exceptions::format_with(format!(
345            "numCodewords {num_codewords}< numDataCodewords{num_data_codewords}"
346        )));
347    }
348    let mut offset = rawbits.len() % codeword_size;
349
350    let mut data_words = vec![0; num_codewords];
351    for word in data_words.iter_mut().take(num_codewords) {
352        // for i in 0..num_codewords {
353        // for (int i = 0; i < numCodewords; i++, offset += codewordSize) {
354        *word = read_code(rawbits, offset, codeword_size) as i32;
355        offset += codeword_size;
356    }
357
358    //try {
359    let rs_decoder = ReedSolomonDecoder::new(gf);
360    rs_decoder.decode(
361        &mut data_words,
362        (num_codewords - num_data_codewords as usize) as i32,
363    )?;
364    //} catch (ReedSolomonException ex) {
365    //throw FormatException.getFormatInstance(ex);
366    //}
367
368    // Now perform the unstuffing operation.
369    // First, count how many bits are going to be thrown out as stuffing
370    let mask = (1 << codeword_size) - 1;
371    let mut stuffed_bits = 0;
372    for data_word in data_words.iter().take(num_data_codewords as usize) {
373        // for i in 0..num_data_codewords as usize {
374        // for (int i = 0; i < numDataCodewords; i++) {
375        // let data_word = data_words[i];
376        if data_word == &0 || data_word == &mask {
377            return Err(Exceptions::FORMAT);
378            //throw FormatException.getFormatInstance();
379        } else if data_word == &1 || data_word == &(mask - 1) {
380            stuffed_bits += 1;
381        }
382    }
383    // Now, actually unpack the bits and remove the stuffing
384    let mut corrected_bits =
385        vec![false; (num_data_codewords * codeword_size as u32 - stuffed_bits) as usize];
386    let mut index = 0;
387    for data_word in data_words.iter().take(num_data_codewords as usize) {
388        // for i in 0..num_data_codewords as usize {
389        // for (int i = 0; i < numDataCodewords; i++) {
390        // let data_word = data_words[i];
391        if *data_word == 1 || *data_word == mask - 1 {
392            // next codewordSize-1 bits are all zeros or all ones
393            corrected_bits.splice(
394                index..index + codeword_size - 1,
395                vec![*data_word > 1; codeword_size - 1],
396            );
397            // Arrays.fill(correctedBits, index, index + codewordSize - 1, dataWord > 1);
398            index += codeword_size - 1;
399        } else {
400            for bit in (0..codeword_size).rev() {
401                // for (int bit = codewordSize - 1; bit >= 0; --bit) {
402                corrected_bits[index] = (*data_word & (1 << bit)) != 0;
403                index += 1;
404            }
405        }
406    }
407
408    Ok(CorrectedBitsRXingResult::new(
409        corrected_bits,
410        (100 * (num_codewords - num_data_codewords as usize) / num_codewords) as u32,
411    ))
412}

414/**
415 * Gets the array of bits from an Aztec Code matrix
416 *
417 * @return the array of bits
418 */
419fn extract_bits(ddata: &AztecDetectorRXingResult, matrix: &BitMatrix) -> Vec<bool> {
420    let compact = ddata.isCompact();
421    let layers = ddata.getNbLayers();
422    let base_matrix_size = ((if compact { 11 } else { 14 }) + layers * 4) as usize; // not including alignment lines
423    let mut alignment_map = vec![0u32; base_matrix_size];
424    let mut rawbits = vec![false; total_bits_in_layer(layers as usize, compact)];
425
426    if compact {
427        for (i, am) in alignment_map.iter_mut().enumerate() {
428            //   for (int i = 0; i < alignmentMap.length; i++) {
429            *am = i as u32;
430        }
431    } else {
432        let matrix_size = base_matrix_size + 1 + 2 * ((base_matrix_size / 2 - 1) / 15);
433        let orig_center = base_matrix_size / 2;
434        let center = matrix_size / 2;
435        for i in 0..orig_center {
436            //   for (int i = 0; i < origCenter; i++) {
437            let new_offset = i + i / 15;
438            alignment_map[orig_center - i - 1] = (center - new_offset - 1) as u32;
439            alignment_map[orig_center + i] = (center + new_offset + 1) as u32;
440        }
441    }
442    let mut row_offset = 0;
443    for i in 0..layers {
444        // for (int i = 0, rowOffset = 0; i < layers; i++) {
445        let row_size = (layers - i) * 4 + (if compact { 9 } else { 12 });
446        // The top-left most point of this layer is <low, low> (not including alignment lines)
447        let low = i * 2;
448        // The bottom-right most point of this layer is <high, high> (not including alignment lines)
449        let high = base_matrix_size as u32 - 1 - low;
450        // We pull bits from the two 2 x rowSize columns and two rowSize x 2 rows
451        for j in 0..row_size {
452            //   for (int j = 0; j < rowSize; j++) {
453            let column_offset = j * 2;
454            for k in 0..2 {
455                // for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
456                // left column
457                rawbits[(row_offset + column_offset + k) as usize] = matrix.get(
458                    alignment_map[(low + k) as usize],
459                    alignment_map[(low + j) as usize],
460                );
461                // bottom row
462                rawbits[(row_offset + 2 * row_size + column_offset + k) as usize] = matrix.get(
463                    alignment_map[(low + j) as usize],
464                    alignment_map[(high - k) as usize],
465                );
466                // right column
467                rawbits[(row_offset + 4 * row_size + column_offset + k) as usize] = matrix.get(
468                    alignment_map[(high - k) as usize],
469                    alignment_map[(high - j) as usize],
470                );
471                // top row
472                rawbits[(row_offset + 6 * row_size + column_offset + k) as usize] = matrix.get(
473                    alignment_map[(high - j) as usize],
474                    alignment_map[(low + k) as usize],
475                );
476            }
477        }
478        row_offset += row_size * 8;
479    }
480    rawbits
481}

483/**
484 * Reads a code of given length and at given index in an array of bits
485 */
486fn read_code(rawbits: &[bool], start_index: usize, length: usize) -> u32 {
487    let mut res = 0;
488    for bit in rawbits.iter().skip(start_index).take(length) {
489        // for i in start_index..start_index + length {
490        // for (int i = startIndex; i < startIndex + length; i++) {
491        res <<= 1;
492        if *bit {
493            res |= 0x01;
494        }
495    }
496    res
497}

499/**
500 * Packs a bit array into bytes, most significant bit first
501 */
502pub fn convertBoolArrayToByteArray(bool_arr: &[bool]) -> Vec<u8> {
503    bool_arr
504        .chunks(8)
505        .map(|chunk| {
506            chunk
507                .iter()
508                .enumerate()
509                .fold(0u8, |acc, (j, &b)| acc | ((b as u8) << (7 - j)))
510        })
511        .collect()
512}
513
514const fn total_bits_in_layer(layers: usize, compact: bool) -> usize {
515    (if compact { 88 } else { 112 } + 16 * layers) * layers
516    // return ((compact ? 88 : 112) + 16 * layers) * layers;
517}
